crossRefs.note: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a…
The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.
I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said, “Strike the tops of the pillars, that the thresholds may shake…
Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.
It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled Yahweh’s house,
when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking Yahweh; and when…
so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled God’s house.
Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings…
The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple…

translations.web: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
translations.bsb: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
translations.kjv: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
translations.asv: And the foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
